title:
And a call, pure, long and throbbing. Longindying call.
 
 Decoy. Soft word. But look: the bright stars fade. Notes chirruping answer
html_source:
The lines are contrapuntal – a musical term for melodic lines moving together.

The longdying call comes from a tuning fork left at the bar, (Gifford).

Lenehan then speaks to the barmaids. Joyce alludes to ‘Goodbye, Sweetheart, Goodbye’.
